**Public demonstration technical summary:** [Bahmni’s DEMO-003 record](https://radiology.demo/bahmni/clinical/) shows a “Demo chest CT” order with accession **ORD-4** in its radiology note. The [matching viewer study](https://radiology.demo/viewer/?mrn=DEMO-003) shows **CT**, **229 DICOM instances**, and a series labelled “LUNG HR 1.25 MM”; an image loaded at **1/229**.

The visible Bahmni note attributes the images to **TCIA COVID-19-NY-SBU (CC BY 4.0)**. No clinical indication or history was supplied in the reviewed record. **No diagnostic interpretation is supplied.**
